title: Wu Zhao (Wu Zetian)
subtitle: A female ruler in power, religious patronage and institutional memory
shortSummary: Wu Zhao's political practice and religious patronage make the institutions, rituals and later memories of Chang'an and Luoyang available for comparison.
curatorialDescription: The museum separates political power, religious patronage and later sacralising narratives instead of treating a tradition's promotional material as a transparent record of rule.
Her entry shows how one person can be written differently across historical records, ritual contexts and later Buddhist or Daoist memories.
researchNote: Alpha entry; inscriptions, official histories, ritual texts and later Buddhist and Daoist narratives require item-level evidence-layer review.
